findings.passage: This is the means by which we would ensure that people who do not provide their driver's license but provide their social security number are verified as being U.S. citizens prior to being registered to vote,
findings.note: Quoted by Magnolia Tribune (article dated 2026-03-10), said to the House before it passed the amended SB 2588 (SHIELD Act) on 2026-03-04. He explains that the bill's citizenship check covers applicants who give a social security number instead of a driver's license number. The article gives no date for the remark; 2026-03-04 is the House passage date the article ties it to.
